title: A background preparation ending never settles close waiters, so a deletion waiting on it sits until the 60 s cap and is Deferred
trigger: Remove an account while its background client is still being prepared (keychain read on a worker) and no other background client runs; the poll loop ends once the cancelled prepare no longer counts as work, then the worker finishes
effect: deletion_wait stays Wait; nothing calls settle_close_waiters when the worker ends (mod.rs:390 only calls prepare.finished); after CLOSE_GIVE_UP the waiter runs with go=false, so the folder stays recorded and is deleted only on the next start, and the key stays in deleting for the run
fix: call settle_close_waiters after prepare.finished (both early-return paths), or make has_work count running preparations

title: EditStage::Loading is a bare mirror of the session's edit-texts fetch, flipped to Editing by hand from frame upkeep
trigger: Open the bot edit box; fill_bot_edit (render upkeep) copies the texts and sets Editing once both are Ready
effect: no bug today; the real stage (session bots.owned.edit name/about Fetch, load_failed) sits beside the dialog's own Loading/Editing and the two are kept in step in fill_bot_edit only
fix: derive loaded from the session fetch, or hold the request id in Loading and settle it in the answer path
